summary: Optimize a distributed application’s critical path while accounting for communication dependencies and shared resource contention.
outcomes: Draw when each communication bucket becomes ready.
Evaluate overlap using end-to-end time and exposed communication.
sequence: Trace compute followed by communication in a baseline.
Split work into ready buckets with explicit dependencies.
Measure contention for SM, memory and link resources.
Compare bucket sizes and scaling efficiency.

visual.question: How much communication remains on the critical path?
visual.interaction: Change bucket size and readiness order; show overlap and exposed tail.

practice.task: Optimize a distributed step with two bucket strategies.
practice.success: Trace demonstrates correctness and an end-to-end result; overlap percentage alone is not used as success.
